external_entities.name: Supplier
external_entities.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork and sign in to the portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: Category manager
external_entities.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: Vendor
external_entities.description: The vendor hosts the SaaS portal and pushes nightly supplier data extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The portal is a SaaS product. The vendor hosts it

processes.name: Supplier document portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload compliance paperwork and category managers review and approve or reject it.
processes.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

processes.name: Supplier master service
processes.description: The service loads the nightly supplier data extract and writes the records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: Vendor platform
data_stores.description: The vendor's platform where supplier compliance documents remain stored.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: Landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket in the organisation's cloud account that receives the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.

data_stores.name: Supplier database
data_stores.description: The database in the organisation's cloud account into which the supplier master service writes extracted records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database

data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork through the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' staff.

data_flows.name: review paperwork
data_flows.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it through the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded compliance paperwork and approval or rejection information.

data_flows.name: store documents
data_flows.description: The portal stores the uploaded documents in the vendor platform.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' staff.

data_flows.name: push extract
data_flows.description: The vendor pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: Encryption claims conflict: System description says, "We were told the nightly extract is encrypted end to end." The runbook says, "the file arrives as a plain CSV".

data_flows.name: load extract
data_flows.description: The supplier master service picks up and loads the nightly extract from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file
data_flows.data_description: Nightly supplier data extract in CSV format.

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes the extracted records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database
data_flows.data_description: Supplier records from the nightly extract.

trust_boundaries.name: Supplier
trust_boundaries.description: The supplier-controlled zone containing suppliers and their own staff context.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: contact details for their own staff

trust_boundaries.name: Vendor hosting
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor-controlled hosting zone for the SaaS portal and vendor platform.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

trust_boundaries.name: Corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: Our cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier document portal presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The source calls it a portal; the extraction convention treats a portal as a web interface.

assumptions.assumption: The compliance paperwork and supplier records are confidential because they include personal staff contact details and business compliance documents.
assumptions.basis: The vendor platform stores insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' staff.

assumptions.assumption: The compliance paperwork and supplier records are confidential because they include personal staff contact details and business compliance documents.
assumptions.basis: The landing bucket receives a supplier data extract containing supplier records.

assumptions.assumption: The compliance paperwork and supplier records are confidential because they include personal staff contact details and business compliance documents.
assumptions.basis: The supplier database stores records loaded from the supplier data extract.

assumptions.assumption: The vendor's statement that it uses enterprise-grade encryption throughout applies to encryption at rest for the vendor platform.
assumptions.basis: The vendor datasheet says the platform uses "enterprise-grade encryption throughout."
